sideConditions: R small enough that the discharge is oscillatory
v(0) uncorrelated with xi(t) for t > 0
axial extent of solute cloud >> a
relative corrections of order (hbar omega / k_B T)^2
Stratonovich integral defined with midpoint rule
phonon mean free path of order 300 nm
Gamma = 4 gamma k_B T (flat white-noise spectrum identified with Nyquist value)
tau is the mean time between reversals
mean squared displacement linear at all times
m -> 0 at fixed gamma and T
m / gamma of a few hundred nanoseconds
initial state is a real Gaussian wavepacket of width sigma_0 centred at x = 0
viscous drag and added mass neglected
averaging volume small compared with k_B T/(m g)
h -> 0 at fixed n and T
